note: Rules of Engineering Practice — how Fresco THINKS. The 7th library, fed by the Operational Knowledge Stream (undocumented organizational knowledge made explicit via interview). Not documents/experiments/standards. Each rule carries a knowledge_class and a confidence_scope (validity boundary). Do NOT generalize beyond confidence_scope.

knowledge_classes.engineering_principle: a structural truth about the product/process (e.g. PSD is part of the formula)
knowledge_classes.production_strategy: how Fresco chooses to produce (e.g. buy fractions, assemble PSD in-house)
knowledge_classes.operational_rule: a do/don't of practice (e.g. don't compensate for out-of-spec raw material)
knowledge_classes.decision_heuristic: an if→then judgment (e.g. QC deviation → investigate raw materials)

rules.rule: Identity variables are NOT compensated — an out-of-spec raw material is rejected, never fixed by changing the formula.
rules.rationale: Identity defines the material; the formula cannot recover a wrong identity.
rules.falsifier: a batch saved to spec purely by reformulating around an out-of-identity raw material

rules.rule: PSD / granulometry is PART of the formula — not a supplier given.
rules.rationale: The distribution is designed, not received.

rules.rule: Premix is a fixed-composition component, identical every batch — and has no separate Batch ID.
Incoming QC precedes production — production starts at the Identity Gate, not at the formula.
Dry-powder QC ≠ liquid QC — dry mortars have no pH/viscosity; their QC is workability, water ratio, visual application, incoming materials, PSD.
rules.falsifier: a dry mortar released on pH/viscosity criteria

rules.rule: Supplier CoA is NOT the final authority — sufficient while there is no problem; on a failure it is re-investigated.
Deep investigation is EVENT-DRIVEN (only after a failure): Granulometry → Raw Materials → Supplier.
Quality is created BEFORE production, not corrected after: Approved RM → Automatic Dosing → Premix → Batch → Workability Test.
Formula ≠ Recipe — a formula is Chemical System + PSD Design + Functional Premix + Manufacturing Strategy.
Fresco buys particle fractions separately and assembles the PSD in-house (PSD is a designed input, not purchased ready).
